messages.author: Big_Sixty60
messages.content_text:
would’ve made $1200 but I was fucking around in pre market  first day implementing tpo chart, and I think it worked very well after only learning it yesterday. I was obviously bullish looking at the date from the last few days based off the value area on the tpo chart. I noticed nq swung back into that value area and took that value high and didn’t reject off it leaving me to believe we would sit around in the poc (point of control) then possibly take value low which we did. What I noticed when we first took the value low we rejected heavily off it and it actually made a 15 minute rejection block which I thought was very interesting. I set a limit buy at the %50 of the rejection block and got put in long for 5 contracts on mnq. I wanted my full tp to be at the highs we made in pre market but nq was lagging too much behind es and we ended up making a bullish smt off that rejection block re trace. I then set my tp to the value area highs and it executed perfectly. I really love this tpo chart after only implementing it with my strategy AFTER LEARNING IT YESTERDAY. If anyone is interested in the tpo chart I have a perfect youtube video this guy explains it so well a toddler could use it. (edited)
Friday, April 17, 2026 at 9:25 AM
